subject: PO and billing policy - consolidated monthly invoice & PO ID mapping
messages:
From: Lila Rahman <lila.rahman@ambassadorhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@ambassadorhealth.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO 77847 - billing cadence, PO line mapping, and early-pay discount request

Hi Alex / Marissa,

Attached is PO 77847 for our upcoming deployment (covers Hosted + Dedicated capacity). Procurement has a couple of requirements we need you to confirm before routing for signature:

- Can Redwood issue a consolidated monthly invoice that lists line items by deployment type (Hosted / Dedicated) but references a single PO number per line?
- Our standard net term is Net60. Can you accept Net60 for this account? If not, what are the options?
- Procurement would like a 3% early-pay discount if we pay within 15 days of invoice. Is Redwood open to an early-pay prompt discount?
- Please confirm the invoice PDF will include: PO number field (PO: 77847), remit-to address, Redwood tax ID, and a monthly statement that groups charges by service.

We also need a sample invoice format to circulate to treasury. Attaching the PO.

Thanks,
Lila
Lila Rahman
Sr. Procurement Manager, Ambassador Health
Attachment: Ambassador_PO_77847.pdf (PDF)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Lila Rahman <lila.rahman@ambassadorhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO 77847 - billing cadence, PO line mapping, and early-pay discount request

Hi Lila — thanks for the PO and clear list. Quick answers & a couple of clarifying asks: 

- Consolidated monthly invoice: yes, we can produce a single monthly PDF that includes separate line items for Hosted vs Dedicated and references PO 77847 on each line. We typically provide a monthly statement that aggregates per-day usage and line-item charges.
- Net terms: our standard for new enterprise commitments is Net45. We can escalate acceptance of Net60 to Finance for this deal, but it usually requires either a signed commitment (term or spend threshold) or a small pricing adjustment.
- Early-pay discount: we do support prompt-pay discounts in certain arrangements. A 3% within 15 days is on the high side for our standard offers; typical is 1–1.5% for Net45 early-pay. If Ambassador can commit to a 12-month minimum spend or prepay a portion, we can be more flexible.
- Invoice fields: we will include PO number, remit-to, Redwood tax ID and can add a GL/charge code column if you provide the mapping you need.

I'll loop in Vivek from finance/ops to propose the concrete options (Net60 approval path vs Net45 + early-pay), and Marissa will confirm the invoice layout. For tracking, here's the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8342 and the quote DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/quotes/XYZ-8890.

Proposed next steps:
- Vivek: propose two finance options (Net45 + 1.5% early-pay OR Net60 w/ smaller discount)
- Marissa: attach a sample invoice template we can send to Ambassador treasury
- Lila: confirm whether Ambassador can accept a term commitment or prepay structure if needed

Thanks — available for a 30m call tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lila Rahman <lila.rahman@ambassadorhealth.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO 77847 - billing cadence, PO line mapping, and early-pay discount request

Hi Lila / team — copying the finance perspective. We looked at the deal profile and can propose two practical options that balance Ambassador's cash cadence needs and Redwood's risk controls: 

Option A (preferred operationally):
- Net45 standard terms, monthly consolidated invoice PDF with per-line PO reference and GL column.
- Early-pay discount: 1.5% if payment received within 15 days.
- No requirement for prepay; we can accept PO 77847 as authorization.

Option B (for Net60 acceptance):
- Net60 term approved subject to either: (a) 3-month rolling minimum commitment, or (b) a 25% upfront deposit that offsets exposure.
- Early-pay discount: 1.0% within 15 days (reduced from your requested 3%).

Operational notes:
- We will produce a consolidated monthly statement (PDF) listing daily usage and invoice line-level detail. Each invoice will include PO: 77847 on every relevant line and a summary page for treasury.
- To automate AR posting on your side we need a single PO field in the invoice PDF and the invoice metadata sent via SFTP or your AP mailbox. Please confirm preferred delivery method.
- Attached is a sample invoice template (invoice_template_lineitems.xlsx) and our billing terms excerpt (redwood_billing_terms_v2.pdf).

If Ambassador is set on a 3% early-pay, the commercial team should flag that as a discount that needs to be offset (either higher price or a buy-down). Happy to run the numbers if you share expected monthly run-rate.

I can authorize Option B (Net60) once we have either the commitment or deposit set; otherwise Option A is the quickest to sign + onboard.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: invoice_template_lineitems.xlsx (XLSX); redwood_billing_terms_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Lila Rahman <lila.rahman@ambassadorhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procure@ambassadorhealth.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO 77847 - billing cadence, PO line mapping, and early-pay discount request

Thanks, Vivek / Alex — this is helpful. Ambassador is willing to accept Option B (Net60) on the condition that Redwood provides the consolidated monthly invoice PDF and a monthly statement that groups charges by service and includes the PO on each line. We will not be putting down an upfront deposit; instead, we will commit to a 6-month minimum spend (details in procurement) which should be sufficient for your exposure model.

Regarding the early-pay discount: we can accept 1.0% within 15 days (revised from our initial 3%), provided the billing statements are delivered via SFTP to ap@ambassadorhealth.com and each invoice includes a machine-readable PO field. Please confirm SFTP endpoint requirements and who on Redwood operations will pick up the load for the initial file mapping.

Once you confirm the SFTP details and the invoice format, we'll route the PO for signature.

Best,
Lila
Lila Rahman
Sr. Procurement Manager, Ambassador Health
